what: Inputs of the second kit that are boolean by declared type alone. What stands here does not count as a refusal: coercion would collapse the third value of such an input into false.

projects/ui-kit-v2/src/lib/components/bu.reason: a tri-state: pressed, not pressed, not said. The third value is what the button is in until the answer arrives, and it is not the same as «not pressed» — coercion would turn it into one.
